profile.headline: Software Engineer at AWS
profile.summary:
5 years software development work experience in the United States with a Masters Degree in Computer Science. 
o Experience working with Microsoft Azure, Typescript, Aurelia, Bulma, C#, Entity Framework, ASP.NET MVC, Web API, Knockout, AngularJS, Bootstrap, HTML5, JavaScript, CSS, Lucene index
o Experience working with Java, JSP
o Strong knowledge in relational database management system fundamentals. Proficient in writing functions, stored procedures, and triggers. Experience working with SQL Server, Oracle.
o Experience in the full life cycle of the software development process including requirements definition, analysis, design, implementation, test, and maintenance.
o Strong work ethic, reliable, dependable performer with ability to demonstrate effective problem solving.

positions.title: Senior Consultant - Software Engineer
positions.description:
Work for Avanade Management Platform team, which offers performance monitoring, remote management and
service management products. The products are developed using Typescript, C#, Microsoft Azure, Azure Log Analytics, ServiceNow, Aurelia, React, Git. 
Work on all aspects of the software development lifecycle from getting requirement, designing, developing, integrating with other systems and deployment.
Develop the deployment projects to automatically deploy function apps, event hubs, configure servers, Azure Log Analytics
Build AMP Mornitoring extension for Visual Studio Code to connect, authenticate and run Powershell script, RestAPIs on remote servers
Build web application to manage alerts, issues, show visual charts, integrate to other systems

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
OilPro is the start-up company that was founded on 2013 to develop professional network websites oilpro.com and tech.pro (was latter taken offline in order to focus on oilpro.com). Oilpro.com targets the oil & gas industry, enables over 650K members around the world to share knowledges, news, images, questions and answers, connect with other professionals in the industry, find and apply for jobs. It is also an excellent tools for recruiter to search for qualified candidates, and for company to connect to their employees, advertise, post jobs. The websites was developed with SQL Server, ASP.Net MVC 4 with Razor, C# 4.5, Javascript, SQL Server, Dapper, HTML, Lucene index, Structuremap, Knockout.js, jQuery, BootStrap, CSS, LESS
- Participated in architectural and design discussion
- Worked with business analysts, graphic designer to convert requirements into software specifications, user interface of the application
- Developed T-SQL procedures, sequence jobs for daily reports, sending news, notifications
- Built a service for asynchronous scraping jobs from multi oil & gas websites
- Built a service for exporting data from SQL Server to Lucene  index for having fast document storage search engine
- Performed system and integration tests 
- Developed smart search keywords recommendation feature (similar to google search)
- Developed the front-end to work across multiple browsers and devices
- Followed agile development process, quickly adapted to constant changes in requirements from users, business
- Mastered the architecture of the system and was able to contribute to the core modules development within 3 months after joining

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Built material Management System (MMS) and Rail Manager web application:  
MMS is an web-based material management systems that integrated with other applications, hardware interface, SAP system. It manages the whole process from materials reception, product mixing, to final chemical products shipment
Rail Manager is a sophisticated web-based Yard inventory system. The system provides railcar tracking, switching, track assignment, loading/unloading information and a complete historical record of all activities. Rail Manager identifies, in real time, the location of each railcar on a graphical map of the yard
- Worked with business analysts to convert business requirements into software specifications
- Created database schemas and UML diagrams
- Wrote SQL scripts to create database tables, views, triggers, table relationships, views and procedures.
- Designed the workflow, use cases of the application.
- Designed and developed the user’s Interface of the application.
- Designed and developed MMS and Rail Manager web application, MMS handheld application based on C#, MVC, AngularJS, Bootstrap, JavaScript, RESTful APIs, Entity Framework, HTML5, CSS, SQL Server, Git
- Designed and developed dynamic reports, user-customized reports using MVC, Restful APIs, AngularJS, OData
- Wrote unit test
- Performed system and integration tests 
- Wrote deployment scripts
- Worked with INEOS, Bayer, Kinder Morgan, BP employees (users) on deployment issues
- Designed and implemented Windows Services, Job tasks on SQL Server
